stories.headline: Alibaba releases Qwen 3.5 small model series (0.8B-9B) with native multimodal and 262K context
key_facts: Four dense models: 0.8B, 2B, 4B, and 9B parameters, all Apache 2.0 licensed
Natively multimodal (text, images, video) from same weights; no separate vision model needed
262K native context window; 9B model supports YaRN extension to ~1M tokens
Gated DeltaNet hybrid architecture with 3:1 linear-to-full attention ratio, multi-token prediction
9B model beats previous-gen Qwen3-30B on most benchmarks and GPT-5-Nano on MMMU-Pro (70.1 vs 57.2)
0.8B runs on ~1.6GB VRAM (BF16), fits on phones with 4-bit quantization
248K token vocabulary covering 201 languages

stories.headline: ETH Zurich demonstrates fault-tolerant lattice surgery on 17-qubit superconducting chip
key_facts: First demonstration of lattice surgery on superconducting quantum circuits, published in Nature Physics
17 flux-tunable transmon qubits: 9 data qubits + 8 auxiliary for stabilizer measurements
Split single surface-code logical qubit into two entangled logical qubits while maintaining error correction
1.66 microsecond stabilizer readout cycle; beyond-breakeven fidelity vs unprotected qubits
Led by Prof. Andreas Wallraff (ETH Zurich) with Paul Scherrer Institute
Lattice surgery is the fundamental operation for scalable fault-tolerant quantum computing
Next step: ~41 physical qubits needed for full phase-flip error correction
